resources.string: Nothing opens by itself. You always choose.
Everything is analysed on your phone. Scanned addresses are not sent anywhere, unless you start an optional check.
Lists of reported sites are downloaded in the background.
You can change this in Settings.
No scan guarantees anything: a new site may be on no list.
Update failed: the previous list is kept.
List refused by the integrity checks. The previous list is kept.
QR code content, the analysis and the results. LookFirst does not record your scans.
Codeberg, the list host, sees your IP address when the lists are updated. Nothing else.
The scanned site sees your IP address and learns that its QR code was scanned.
RDAP registry: your IP address and the domain name.
A new or unreported site can be malicious. Stay alert.

LookFirst uses ZXing and AndroidX (Apache License 2.0). The reputation lists contain the Public Suffix List (Mozilla Public License 2.0) and data from Phishing.Database (MIT License); the NOTICE.txt file shipped with each list gives the details.
